semantics.availability_rule: Availability means the declared service/data path can satisfy the requested profile, not merely that transport is reachable.
semantics.completeness_rule: Completeness reflects required source/data coverage according to an explicit profile.
semantics.federation_rule: Missing/denied/timed-out required origins affect completeness explicitly.
semantics.quality_rule: Data quality failure and unavailability are separate evidence dimensions.
semantics.authorization_rule: Denied access is not reported as ordinary unavailability when policy-safe distinction is required internally.

invariants.rule: Freshness, availability, completeness, latency and SLO results are derived service-health evidence over exact data/runtime scopes; they never change data identity, ownership, classification, authorization or execution authority.

hard_gates.condition: denied source silently treated as empty dataset
